build_SelectByAction: build a meta-network input transform that selects values by action using batch lookup
build_PiWeightedAvg: build a policy-weighted average transform that computes weighted sums over action axis
build_EmaNorm: build an EMA normalization module that normalizes inputs by exponential moving average of mean and variance
build_td_pair: build a function that concatenates inputs at time t and t+1 for TD-error calculation
build_tx_factory: build a wrapper that adapts single-arg transforms to the standard four-arg input transform interface
